display_name: Pregnancy leg cramp
tip_1: Gently stretch the calf (toe upward) when a cramp hits.
tip_2: Stay hydrated; light evening walks if your clinician allows.
tip_3: A warm pack after the cramp may ease residual ache.
tip_4: Review safe magnesium/calcium options only with your clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for one-sided swelling/redness, chest pain, or severe persistent pain.

aliases: baby colic|iyak gabi sanggol|colic cry|piky baby evenings
display_name: Infant colic comfort
tip_1: Check basic needs first: feed, diaper, temperature, burping.
tip_2: Gentle rocking, white noise, or a calm walk in a safe carrier may soothe.
tip_3: Ensure caregivers take turns — never shake a baby.
tip_4: Track crying patterns for the clinician visit.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for fever in young infants, poor feeding, vomiting green bile, breathing trouble, or a baby who is unusually limp/sleepy.

aliases: teething fuss|iyak nangingipin|teething irritability
display_name: Teething irritability
tip_1: Offer supervised cool teething rings; gentle gum massage with a clean finger.
tip_2: Extra cuddles and routine keep babies calmer.
tip_3: Treat true fever as fever — teething alone rarely causes high fever.
tip_4: Avoid amber necklaces and unapproved gels.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for high fever, dehydration, rash, or soft spot concerns — do not assume “just teething.”

aliases: pregnancy constipation|hirap tumae buntis|constipated pregnant
display_name: Pregnancy constipation
tip_1: Drink water regularly; add fiber foods gradually if tolerated.
tip_2: Walk daily if your clinician approves activity.
tip_3: Do not ignore the urge to stool.
tip_4: Ask your maternity clinician before any laxative.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe pain, vomiting, or no stool with swelling.

aliases: uti prevention|iwas uti|prevent urine infection
display_name: UTI prevention habits
tip_1: Drink enough water through the day unless fluid-restricted.
tip_2: Do not hold urine for long hours; urinate after sex if applicable.
tip_3: Wipe front to back; avoid irritating feminine sprays.
tip_4: Wear breathable cotton underwear.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for burning urination, fever, back pain, or blood in urine — prevention tips are not treatment.

aliases: kidney stone watch|sakit tagiliran ihi|flank pain fluids|possible stone fluids
display_name: Flank pain — fluid focus (watch)
tip_1: Sip water steadily if you can keep fluids down and pain is mild.
tip_2: Use heat on the back for comfort while arranging clinical advice.
tip_3: Strain urine only if a clinician asked you to catch a stone.
tip_4: Avoid high-dose unprescribed pain cocktails.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for severe colic, vomiting, fever with flank pain, or inability to urinate — stones can be emergencies.

aliases: wart|verruca|kulugo|veruca|plantar wart|common wart
display_name: Warts / verrucas
tip_1: Wash hands after touching a wart; cover with a plaster when swimming.
tip_2: Change socks daily for foot verrucas; do not share towels, socks, or shoes.
tip_3: Pharmacy wart treatments may help if used as labeled for weeks — do not use on face/genitals.
tip_4: Do not pick, bite, or shave over warts; avoid barefoot walking in public wet areas with a verruca.
when_to_seek_care: See a clinician for facial/genital warts, bleeding/changing growths, very painful/large lesions, or if unsure it is a wart.

aliases: fungal nail|impeksyon kuko|onychomycosis mild|yellow thick nail
display_name: Mild fungal nail
tip_1: Keep nails trimmed short and dry; wear breathable shoes and change socks daily.
tip_2: Do not share nail clippers; disinfect tools.
tip_3: Pharmacy antifungal nail products need long courses and do not always clear infection — ask a pharmacist.
tip_4: Treat athlete’s foot at the same time if present to reduce spread.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if you have diabetes, severe pain/swelling, or the nail bed looks infected.

aliases: psoriasis mild|psoriasis flare|scaly patches|balat psoriasis
display_name: Mild psoriasis flare
tip_1: Moisturize thickly and often with fragrance-free cream.
tip_2: Use lukewarm showers; pat dry; avoid harsh scrubbing.
tip_3: Ask a pharmacist about coal tar/salicylic or vitamin D-style topicals suitable for you.
tip_4: Manage stress and protect skin from injury that can trigger plaques.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for rapidly spreading plaques, joint swelling/pain with psoriasis, or infected cracked skin.

aliases: rosacea|red face flush|pamumula mukha|facial redness chronic mild
display_name: Mild rosacea flush
tip_1: Use gentle fragrance-free cleanser and moisturizer; avoid scrubbing.
tip_2: Identify triggers (sun, spicy food, alcohol, heat) and reduce exposure.
tip_3: Wear sunscreen daily on the face.
tip_4: Ask a clinician before steroid creams on the face — they can worsen rosacea.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for eye irritation with rosacea, painful cysts, or worsening redness that affects confidence/comfort.

aliases: tinnitus|tenga ingay|ringing ears|buzzing ears|ugong tenga
display_name: Mild tinnitus
tip_1: Avoid total silence — soft background sound or music can reduce focus on the noise.
tip_2: Protect sleep with a regular bedtime; cut late caffeine if it worsens symptoms.
tip_3: Reduce stress with slow breathing; avoid very loud noise exposure.
tip_4: Do not poke the ears; check if wax or infection could be contributing.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if tinnitus is constant/worsening, pulse-synchronous, follows head injury, or comes with sudden hearing loss, facial weakness, or vertigo.

aliases: blocked nose|baradong ilong|stuffy nose only|hindi makahinga ilong
display_name: Blocked nose
tip_1: Use saline nasal spray/rinse several times a day.
tip_2: Breathe mild steam; keep the room humidified if air is dry.
tip_3: Sleep with the head slightly elevated.
tip_4: Limit decongestant sprays to a few days only to avoid rebound blockage.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if blockage lasts weeks on one side, with bloody/foul discharge, facial swelling, or breathing difficulty.

aliases: tonsillitis|inflamed tonsils|sakit tonsil|tonsils swollen mild
display_name: Tonsillitis home care
tip_1: Rest, drink warm fluids, and use soft cool foods if swallowing hurts.
tip_2: Gargle warm salt water if able; lozenges may soothe adults.
tip_3: Labeled fever/pain medicine may help comfort if suitable.
tip_4: Antibiotics are not always needed — many cases are viral.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for drooling, breathing trouble, inability to swallow saliva, stiff neck, or severe one-sided throat swelling.

aliases: middle ear infection|otitis media watch|sakit tenga batang lagnat|ear infection watch
display_name: Middle-ear infection watch
tip_1: Give age-appropriate pain/fever medicine only as labeled if suitable.
tip_2: Keep the child upright for feeds/drinks; offer extra fluids.
tip_3: Do not insert oil or buds into the ear.
tip_4: Most mild cases improve in a few days with supportive care.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for under-3-month fever, severe pain, swelling behind the ear, discharge, vomiting with lethargy, or symptoms lasting beyond a few days.

aliases: labyrinthitis|vertigo infection|spinning with cold|hilo with ear
display_name: Mild labyrinthitis-like dizziness
tip_1: Lie still in a safe place during spinning spells; rise slowly.
tip_2: Sip water; avoid driving or climbing while dizzy.
tip_3: Rest as the viral illness settles; keep lights gentle if motion worsens symptoms.
tip_4: Do not take leftover vestibular drugs without advice.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for new facial weakness, severe headache, chest pain, fainting, or dizziness with neurological deficits.

aliases: shingles|herpes zoster|kulebra|painful one-side rash|shingles rash
display_name: Shingles watch
tip_1: Do not scratch blisters; keep the area clean and covered loosely.
tip_2: Avoid contact with pregnant people, newborns, and those with weak immunity until crusted.
tip_3: Use cool compresses for comfort; labeled pain relief if suitable.
tip_4: Antivirals work best early — contact a clinician promptly when a painful one-sided blistering rash appears.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for rash near the eye, vision changes, widespread rash, or severe weakness.

aliases: scarlet fever|scarletina|red sandpaper rash fever|lagnat with scarlet rash
display_name: Scarlet fever watch
tip_1: Rest and drink fluids; use labeled fever medicine if suitable.
tip_2: Note sore throat plus fine red rash for the clinician.
tip_3: Practice hand hygiene; limit close contact while awaiting advice.
tip_4: Do not share utensils/towels during illness.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care promptly — scarlet fever usually needs clinical assessment/antibiotics; urgent if breathing trouble or severe lethargy.

aliases: mumps|bayoka|swollen jaw glands|parotitis watch
display_name: Mumps watch
tip_1: Rest, soft foods, and cold/warm compresses on swollen glands.
tip_2: Isolate as advised locally; avoid close contact with unvaccinated people.
tip_3: Drink fluids; labeled pain/fever medicine if suitable.
tip_4: Watch for severe headache, vomiting, or testicular pain.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for breathing/swallowing trouble, severe headache, or suspected mumps — public-health guidance may apply.

aliases: glandular fever|mono|infectious mononucleosis|kissing disease mild
display_name: Glandular fever (mono) home care
tip_1: Rest more than usual; return to sport only when a clinician clears you (spleen risk).
tip_2: Drink fluids; soft foods if the throat is very sore.
tip_3: Use labeled fever/pain medicine if suitable.
tip_4: Avoid alcohol while recovering.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for difficulty breathing/swallowing, severe abdominal pain, jaundice, or fainting.

aliases: molluscum|water warts|molluscum contagiosum|butlig tubig balat
display_name: Molluscum comfort
tip_1: Do not squeeze the bumps; keep nails short.
tip_2: Avoid sharing towels and pooling equipment when lesions are open.
tip_3: Cover lesions for contact sports if practical.
tip_4: Most clear over months without treatment in healthy children.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if lesions look infected, are near the eyes/genitals, or you have weak immunity.

aliases: chilblains|pantal lamig|cold itchy toes|pernio mild
display_name: Chilblains
tip_1: Warm the area gradually — do not put ice-cold feet on a heater suddenly.
tip_2: Keep hands/feet dry and warm with layered socks/gloves.
tip_3: Moisturize gently; avoid massaging broken chilblain skin hard.
tip_4: Stop smoking if applicable — it worsens circulation.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for broken skin infection, severe pain, or color changes that worry you.

aliases: raynaud mild|cold fingers white|daliri puti lamig|cold pale fingers
display_name: Mild cold fingers (Raynaud-like)
tip_1: Warm hands gradually with gloves and warm (not scalding) water.
tip_2: Avoid sudden cold exposure and tight rings during attacks.
tip_3: Reduce smoking and excess caffeine if they trigger attacks.
tip_4: Wiggle/swing arms gently to restore color when safe.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for sores on fingertips, persistent blue color, or one-sided severe symptoms.

aliases: osteoarthritis mild|sakit joints tumatanda|wear and tear joint|OA mild
display_name: Mild osteoarthritis comfort
tip_1: Stay active with low-impact walking/swimming as tolerated.
tip_2: Maintain a healthy weight to reduce joint load.
tip_3: Warm packs before activity and ice after if swollen.
tip_4: Supportive shoes and activity pacing beat total rest.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for hot swollen joints, locking, sudden inability to walk, or fever with joint pain.

aliases: bunion|joanete|hallux valgus pain|sakit joanete
display_name: Bunion comfort
tip_1: Choose wider toe-box shoes; avoid high heels while painful.
tip_2: Use bunion pads or soft spacers if they reduce rub.
tip_3: Ice briefly after long standing; rest and elevate.
tip_4: Toe stretches and foot-strength work may help mild cases.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for open sores (especially with diabetes), severe deformity pain, or infection signs.

aliases: anal itch|kati puwit|pruritus ani|kati sa pwet
display_name: Anal itch hygiene
tip_1: Wash with water after stool; pat dry — avoid harsh soaps and scented wipes.
tip_2: Wear cotton underwear; avoid tight synthetics.
tip_3: Do not overuse medicated creams; short pharmacy options only as labeled.
tip_4: Keep stools soft with fiber and water to reduce wiping trauma.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for bleeding, lumps, severe pain, or itch lasting despite hygiene — pinworms/other causes may need treatment.

aliases: ibs flare|irritable bowel mild|ibs tiyan|gas ibs
display_name: Mild IBS-type flare
tip_1: Eat smaller regular meals; note trigger foods in a simple diary.
tip_2: Sip water; a short walk after meals can ease cramps for some.
tip_3: Limit excess caffeine, alcohol, and sugar-free polyols if they trigger you.
tip_4: Heat pack on the abdomen may comfort cramps.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for bleeding, weight loss, fever, waking at night with pain, or new symptoms after age 50 — get clinical review.

aliases: lactose intolerance|hindi kaya gatas|gas after milk|diarrhea after dairy
display_name: Lactose intolerance self-care
tip_1: Reduce lactose portions; try lactose-free milk if needed.
tip_2: Yogurt/hard cheese are sometimes better tolerated — test small amounts.
tip_3: Read labels for hidden milk sugars.
tip_4: Do not cut all nutrition groups long-term without advice.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for weight loss, blood in stool, or symptoms in infants — confirm cause with a clinician.

aliases: hernia mild|luslos|bulge groin|umbilical hernia discomfort
display_name: Mild hernia discomfort
tip_1: Avoid heavy lifting and straining while symptomatic.
tip_2: Support the area when coughing; keep stools soft.
tip_3: Do not try to forcefully push a painful stuck bulge repeatedly.
tip_4: Discuss elective repair timing with a clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care if a bulge becomes painful, red, tender, and will not reduce, with vomiting — possible strangulation.

aliases: fainting recovery|nahilo bagsak|syncope mild recovery|nawalan ng ulirat brief
display_name: After a brief faint
tip_1: Lie flat and elevate the legs until fully alert; sit up slowly afterward.
tip_2: Loosen tight clothing; sip water when awake.
tip_3: Note triggers (heat, standing long, missed meals, fright).
tip_4: Do not drive until cleared if faints recur.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for chest pain, irregular heartbeat, seizure-like movements, head injury from the fall, or repeated unexplained faints.

aliases: panic attack|atake panic|kabado bigla|anxiety attack mild
display_name: Panic attack grounding
tip_1: Name 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear — grounding can shorten the peak.
tip_2: Breathe slowly: longer exhale than inhale for a few minutes.
tip_3: Remind yourself the peak usually passes within minutes.
tip_4: Reduce caffeine if panic is frequent.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent help for chest pain you cannot tell from panic, fainting, or thoughts of self-harm; see a clinician if attacks keep returning.

aliases: snoring|hilik|maingay tulog|snore mild
display_name: Snoring self-care
tip_1: Try side-sleeping; elevate the head of the bed slightly.
tip_2: Avoid alcohol near bedtime; clear nasal congestion with saline.
tip_3: Maintain a healthy weight if advised; treat nasal allergies.
tip_4: Keep a consistent sleep schedule.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for witnessed breathing pauses, gasping awake, morning headaches, or severe daytime sleepiness — possible sleep apnea.

aliases: loss of smell|anosmia mild|walang amoy|reduced smell post cold
display_name: Reduced sense of smell
tip_1: Treat lingering cold/allergy with saline rinses.
tip_2: Practice smell training with safe familiar scents if recommended.
tip_3: Ensure smoke/gas detector batteries work at home for safety.
tip_4: Avoid strong chemical exposures while recovering.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for sudden smell loss with head injury, neurological symptoms, or loss lasting many weeks.

aliases: swollen glands|namamagang lymph|gland near jaw|bukol leeg mild tender
display_name: Mild tender swollen glands
tip_1: Rest and hydrate while a mild viral illness settles.
tip_2: Warm compress over tender nodes may comfort.
tip_3: Do not squeeze swollen glands.
tip_4: Most tender nodes with a cold improve in 1–2 weeks.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for hard fixed nodes, night sweats with weight loss, nodes lasting >2 weeks, or difficulty breathing/swallowing.

aliases: night sweats|gabing pawis|sweating at night mild
display_name: Mild night sweats
tip_1: Use lighter bedding and a cooler room; wear breathable sleepwear.
tip_2: Limit alcohol and spicy late meals.
tip_3: Change damp clothes to stay comfortable.
tip_4: Note fever, cough, or weight change for your clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for drenching sweats with fever, unexplained weight loss, or swollen nodes — needs clinical review.

aliases: whooping cough|tosse convulsiva|pertussis watch|ubong may whoop
display_name: Whooping-cough watch
tip_1: Rest and drink fluids; avoid smoke exposure.
tip_2: Note coughing fits with whoop/vomit for urgent clinical advice.
tip_3: Limit contact with infants and pregnant people while awaiting care.
tip_4: Vaccination history matters — tell the clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care promptly for suspected pertussis; urgent if breathing pauses, blue lips, or infant exposure/illness.

aliases: croup|tahol na ubo|barking cough child|laryngotracheitis watch
display_name: Croup watch
tip_1: Keep the child calm; upright cuddling can ease breathing effort.
tip_2: Offer fluids; use labeled fever care if suitable.
tip_3: Cool night air sometimes eases mild barky cough — stay with the child.
tip_4: Do not give cough suppressants casually to young children.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for stridor at rest, drooling, blue lips, or severe distress.

aliases: bronchiolitis|ubo bata ginhawa|rsv watch infant|baby wheeze watch
display_name: Bronchiolitis watch
tip_1: Offer smaller more frequent feeds/fluids; keep the nose clear with saline if advised.
tip_2: Watch breathing rate and wet diapers closely.
tip_3: Avoid smoke exposure; practice hand hygiene.
tip_4: Most viral cases are supportive care only.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for poor feeding, fewer wet diapers, pauses in breathing, blue lips, or working hard to breathe.

aliases: pneumonia watch|possible pneumonia|ubo with breathlessness fever|bagang infection watch
display_name: Pneumonia watch
tip_1: Rest and hydrate while arranging clinical assessment — do not rely on home tips alone.
tip_2: Note fever, cough, and breathlessness timeline.
tip_3: Use labeled fever medicine if suitable while seeking care.
tip_4: Avoid smoke.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for fast breathing, chest pain, confusion, blue lips, or inability to drink — pneumonia needs clinical care.

aliases: appendicitis watch|sakit kanan tiyan|possible apendicitis|rebound tummy pain
display_name: Appendicitis watch
tip_1: Do not take laxatives or heavy meals if appendicitis is possible.
tip_2: Note pain moving to the lower right abdomen with nausea/fever.
tip_3: Sip clear fluids only while getting urgent assessment.
tip_4: Do not apply strong heat as your only plan.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent emergency care for worsening localized abdominal pain, vomiting, fever, or rigid abdomen.

aliases: gallbladder watch|sakit kanan after fatty|biliary colic watch|gallstone pain watch
display_name: Gallbladder pain watch
tip_1: Avoid fatty heavy meals while arranging clinical advice.
tip_2: Rest upright; sip clear fluids if not vomiting heavily.
tip_3: Note pain under the right ribs radiating to the shoulder.
tip_4: Do not ignore fever with this pain pattern.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for severe persistent pain, fever, jaundice, or vomiting that prevents fluids.

aliases: low sugar known diabetic|hypoglycemia|hilo diabetes low sugar|tremor low glucose
display_name: Low blood sugar (known diabetes)
tip_1: If safe and prescribed a plan: take fast sugar (glucose tablets/juice) then a snack as taught.
tip_2: Recheck glucose per your clinician’s plan.
tip_3: Sit/lie down; do not drive during a low.
tip_4: Keep glucose sources accessible if you use insulin/certain tablets.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency help if confused, seizing, unconscious, or unable to swallow — glucagon/emergency services as trained.

aliases: high sugar watch|hyperglycemia|tuyo bibig diabetes high|high glucose symptoms
display_name: High blood sugar watch
tip_1: Follow your sick-day rules from your diabetes clinician; hydrate if allowed.
tip_2: Check glucose/ketones as taught; do not skip prescribed insulin without advice.
tip_3: Note vomiting, fast breathing, or fruity breath as emergencies.
tip_4: Rest and avoid strenuous exercise if glucose is very high with ketones.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for very high readings with vomiting, confusion, or breathing changes.

aliases: wound dressing|palit bendahe|change bandage|hiwa dressing
display_name: Simple wound dressing care
tip_1: Wash hands before and after dressing changes.
tip_2: Clean as advised with saline/water; pat dry.
tip_3: Use a clean non-stick dressing; change if wet/dirty.
tip_4: Watch for increasing redness, pus, or fever.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for spreading infection, red streaks, wound reopening, or tetanus concerns.

aliases: chemical splash skin|nabuhusan kemikal|detergent burn skin|bleach on skin
display_name: Chemical on skin (first aid)
tip_1: Remove contaminated clothing carefully; rinse skin with running water for 20 minutes.
tip_2: Do not neutralize with random household chemicals.
tip_3: Cover loosely with clean dressing after rinsing.
tip_4: Take the chemical container/label to care if you go.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for eye exposure, large burns, breathing symptoms, or strong industrial chemicals.

aliases: chemical in eye|nabuhusan mata kemikal|bleach in eye|acid eye splash
display_name: Chemical in eye
tip_1: Irrigate immediately with clean water/saline for at least 15–20 minutes, holding lids open.
tip_2: Remove contact lenses if easy while rinsing.
tip_3: Do not delay rinsing to find special drops first.
tip_4: Keep rinsing on the way to care if possible.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care after any chemical eye splash — even if it starts to feel better.

aliases: animal bite|kagat aso|kagat pusa|dog bite|cat bite
display_name: Animal bite
tip_1: Wash thoroughly with soap and water for several minutes.
tip_2: Control bleeding with clean pressure; cover with a sterile dressing.
tip_3: Do not seal deep punctures tightly with grease.
tip_4: Note the animal’s vaccine status if known.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for all cat bites, deep dog bites, bat exposure, facial bites, or if tetanus/rabies risk is possible.

aliases: human bite|kagat tao|bite from person
display_name: Human bite
tip_1: Wash with soap and water promptly.
tip_2: Control bleeding; apply a clean dressing.
tip_3: Keep the limb elevated if swollen.
tip_4: Do not ignore small knuckle bites from punches — they can infect deeply.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent clinical care for antibiotics assessment — human bites have high infection risk.

aliases: jellyfish sting|hapong dikya|jellyfish|kagat dikya
display_name: Jellyfish sting (mild)
tip_1: Rinse with seawater (not freshwater) to remove tentacles; wear gloves if possible.
tip_2: Remove tentacles with a card edge; soak in hot water as tolerated for pain if recommended locally.
tip_3: Avoid urine, alcohol rubs, or rubbing sand hard.
tip_4: Oral labeled pain relief may help if suitable.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for difficulty breathing, widespread rash, chest pain, or stings to the eye.

aliases: bee sting|wasp sting|kagat bubuyog|putakti|stinger
display_name: Bee / wasp sting
tip_1: Scrape (don’t squeeze) a visible bee stinger out promptly.
tip_2: Wash with soap and water; cool compress for swelling.
tip_3: Oral antihistamine/pain relief may help if suitable and labeled.
tip_4: Elevate a stung limb if swollen.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care for facial/tongue swelling, wheeze, dizziness, or known severe allergy — use epinephrine if prescribed.

aliases: tick bite|kagat garapata|tick on skin|garapata
display_name: Tick bite
tip_1: Remove the tick with fine tweezers close to the skin, pulling steady upward.
tip_2: Clean the area with soap and water; save the tick in a container if advised.
tip_3: Do not use heat/oil folklore methods that leave mouthparts.
tip_4: Watch for expanding rash or fever in following weeks.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if the tick’s head remains, rash expands (bull’s-eye), fever develops, or you were in a high-risk area.

aliases: shift work sleep|gising gabi trabaho|night shift pagod|rotating shift sleep
display_name: Shift-work sleep tips
tip_1: Use blackout curtains and a consistent post-shift sleep block.
tip_2: Limit caffeine in the second half of the shift.
tip_3: Dark glasses on the way home can help daytime sleep onset.
tip_4: Protect at least one longer sleep opportunity on days off when possible.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if sleep loss causes safety risks, depression, or near-miss accidents at work.

aliases: caregiver fatigue|pagod mag-alaga|burnout caregiver|alaga pagod
display_name: Caregiver fatigue
tip_1: Ask for practical help with specific tasks; short breaks matter.
tip_2: Keep one non-negotiable rest or walk slot daily if possible.
tip_3: Eat regular meals and hydrate — skipping basics worsens burnout.
tip_4: Talk to a trusted person or support group.
when_to_seek_care: Seek help if you feel hopeless, angry to the point of unsafe care, or depressed — caregiver support is health care too.

aliases: sprain strain price|PRICE therapy|sprain home|strain home nhs
display_name: Sprain / strain PRICE care
tip_1: Use PRICE for 2–3 days: protect, rest, ice (wrapped) up to 20 minutes, compression if safe, elevate.
tip_2: Avoid heat, alcohol, and deep massage in the first couple of days.
tip_3: Start gentle movement when pain allows so the area does not stiffen.
tip_4: Pharmacy pain gels/tablets may help if suitable for you.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for a crack sound, deformity, numbness, inability to walk, or no improvement after home care.

aliases: black eye|pasa sa mata|shiner|pasa paligid mata
display_name: Mild black eye
tip_1: Apply a cool compress with a cloth barrier for short periods in the first day.
tip_2: Keep the head elevated when resting; avoid pressing the eyeball.
tip_3: Do not put raw meat or unproven pastes on the eye.
tip_4: Acetaminophen may help ache if suitable and labeled for you.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for vision change, blood on the eye surface, inability to move the eye, or head-injury warning signs.

aliases: recurrent stye|ulit kuliti|stye comes back
display_name: Recurrent stye hygiene
tip_1: Replace eye makeup every few months; never share mascara.
tip_2: Wash hands before touching lids; warm compress at first sign.
tip_3: Avoid greasy creams along the lash line while healing.
tip_4: Lid hygiene with diluted baby shampoo or lid wipes if advised.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for recurrent styes, vision change, or whole-lid swelling.

aliases: blepharitis|inflamed eyelids|gilagid talukap|crusty lids
display_name: Mild blepharitis
tip_1: Warm compresses daily to loosen crusts on the lid margins.
tip_2: Gently clean lids with recommended lid wipes or diluted cleanser.
tip_3: Avoid waterproof mascara until calmer.
tip_4: Artificial tears may soothe if the ocular surface is dry.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe redness, vision loss, or sores on the lids.

aliases: red patch on eye|dugo sa puti ng mata|subconjunctival hemorrhage
display_name: Red patch on white of eye
tip_1: Usually painless bright red patches clear over 1–2 weeks without special drops.
tip_2: Avoid rubbing; artificial tears if scratchy.
tip_3: Note if you strain, cough hard, or take blood thinners.
tip_4: Do not try to drain the red area.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for pain, vision change, trauma, or repeated unexplained bleeds.

aliases: eye floaters|lumilipad sa mata|floaters mild
display_name: Mild eye floaters
tip_1: Most occasional floaters are benign; note sudden showers of new floaters.
tip_2: Avoid staring at bright empty skies while anxious about them.
tip_3: Protect eyes from injury; attend routine eye checks if overdue.
tip_4: Write down onset timing for your clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for sudden many floaters, flashes, a curtain over vision, or eye injury.

aliases: light sensitivity|takot sa liwanag|photophobia mild
display_name: Mild light sensitivity
tip_1: Rest in a dimmer room; wear sunglasses outdoors.
tip_2: Limit screen glare; use lubricating drops if eyes feel dry.
tip_3: Check if new medicines might contribute — ask a pharmacist.
tip_4: Hydrate and rest if it came with a migraine pattern you know.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for light sensitivity with stiff neck, severe headache, eye injury, or vision loss.

aliases: watery eyes cold|luha mata sipon|tearing with cold
display_name: Watery eyes with cold
tip_1: Treat the cold with fluids and saline nose spray to reduce tear overflow from congestion.
tip_2: Wipe tears gently downward; avoid rubbing.
tip_3: Warm compress if lids feel irritated.
tip_4: Change pillowcases while sick.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for painful red eye, vision change, or thick yellow discharge.

aliases: ear pressure flight|barado tenga eroplano|airplane ear
display_name: Airplane ear pressure
tip_1: Yawn, swallow, or chew gum during ascent/descent.
tip_2: Try a gentle Valsalva only if you were taught and have no cold with severe block.
tip_3: Stay awake for landing when possible; use filtered earplugs if helpful.
tip_4: Avoid flying with a severe cold if you can reschedule.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe pain, hearing loss lasting days, or dizziness after flying.

aliases: itchy ears|kati tenga|ear canal itch
display_name: Itchy ear canals
tip_1: Do not insert cotton buds — they worsen itch and wax push.
tip_2: Ask a pharmacist about suitable ear drops for dry itchy canals.
tip_3: Keep soap/shampoo out of the canals in the shower.
tip_4: Treat eczema behind the ears with gentle moisturizer if present.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for discharge, severe pain, swelling, or hearing loss.

aliases: angular cheilitis|bitak gilid bibig|cracked mouth corners
display_name: Cracked mouth corners
tip_1: Keep corners clean and dry; apply a plain barrier ointment.
tip_2: Avoid licking the corners; treat underlying dryness.
tip_3: Review denture fit if you wear them — moisture pooling worsens cracks.
tip_4: Ask a pharmacist about antifungal cream if yeast is suspected.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if cracks bleed, spread, or last more than 1–2 weeks.

aliases: geographic tongue|mapa dila|benign migratory glossitis
display_name: Geographic tongue
tip_1: Avoid spicy acidic foods during sensitive flares.
tip_2: Stay hydrated; use a soft toothbrush.

tip_2: Check back/scalp with help or mirrors.

tip_4: Do not cut or freeze moles at home.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care promptly for changing, bleeding, or new unusual moles.

aliases: skin tag|kulugat|acrochordon irritation
display_name: Skin tag irritation
tip_1: Keep the area clean; avoid jewelry that snags tags.
tip_2: Do not tie off tags with string at home if inflamed.
tip_3: Loose clothing reduces rub.
tip_4: Moisturize surrounding skin.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for bleeding, infection, or removal options — especially if uncertain it is a tag.

aliases: lipoma|tambok bukol|fatty lump under skin
display_name: Lipoma-type lump watch
tip_1: Most soft mobile lumps are benign — confirm with a clinician when new.
tip_2: Avoid trauma to the area; no home lancing.
tip_3: Note growth rate and pain.
tip_4: Maintain healthy weight habits overall.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for rapid growth, hard fixed lumps, or pain — needs examination.

aliases: flight swollen ankles|mamaga paa eroplano|travel edema
display_name: Flight ankle swelling
tip_1: Walk the aisle when allowed; ankle pumps while seated.
tip_2: Hydrate; limit excess alcohol on long flights.
tip_3: Loose shoes; compression socks if suitable for you.
tip_4: Elevate legs after landing.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for one-sided painful swelling — possible clot risk especially after long travel.
resource_label: NHS: Sprains and strains / joint pain

aliases: dvt watch|sakit binti isa|possible clot leg
display_name: Possible leg clot watch
tip_1: Do not massage a hot swollen one-sided calf hard.
tip_2: Note recent surgery, travel, hormones, or cancer history for the clinician.
tip_3: Keep the leg elevated while arranging urgent assessment.
tip_4: Avoid starting leftover blood thinners without advice.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for one-sided swelling/pain/redness — and emergency care if chest pain/breathlessness.

aliases: varicose bleed|dumudugo ugat binti|vein bleed leg
display_name: Bleeding varicose vein first aid
tip_1: Lie down; elevate the leg; press firmly with a clean cloth.
tip_2: Do not apply a tourniquet as first line for simple vein bleeds.
tip_3: Seek care after to review vein treatment options.
tip_4: Keep walking plans as advised later to help circulation.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care if bleeding will not stop or you feel faint.

aliases: broken nose watch|baka bali ilong|nose injury
display_name: Nose injury watch
tip_1: Sit forward; ice wrapped around the nose/cheeks; control bleeding with pinch if no severe deformity advice conflicts.
tip_2: Do not straighten a crooked nose yourself.
tip_3: Sleep elevated; avoid contact sports briefly.
tip_4: Acetaminophen preferred over NSAIDs early if bleeding risk — ask advice.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for deformity, clear fluid leak, vision change, or breathing blockage.

aliases: knocked tooth|natanggal ngipin|avulsed tooth
display_name: Knocked-out tooth
tip_1: Pick up by the crown not the root; if dirty, rinse briefly with milk/saline — do not scrub.
tip_2: Replant in socket if an adult tooth and you can, or store in milk; see dentist immediately.
tip_3: Bite on gauze to hold position if replanted.
tip_4: Act within 30–60 minutes when possible.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency dental care immediately — time critical for saving the tooth.

aliases: cracked tooth|bitak ngipin|cracked cusp
display_name: Cracked tooth comfort
tip_1: Avoid chewing on that side; soft foods.
tip_2: Sensitive toothpaste may help mildly; avoid ice biting.
tip_3: Rinse gently; do not use the tooth as a tool.
tip_4: Save any broken fragments in milk for the dentist.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent dental care for severe pain, swelling, or sharp edges cutting the tongue.

aliases: lost filling|natanggal Tambal|temporary filling lost
display_name: Lost filling temporary care
tip_1: Avoid chewing on that side; keep the cavity clean with gentle rinses.
tip_2: Pharmacy temporary filling material may help short-term if used as labeled.
tip_3: Avoid very sticky/hard foods.
tip_4: Pain relief if suitable while arranging dental repair.
when_to_seek_care: See a dentist promptly — temporary fixes are not permanent.

aliases: retainer sore|sakit retainer|aligner sore
display_name: Retainer/aligner soreness
tip_1: Wear as prescribed; soft foods first days of a new tray/wire.
tip_2: Ortho wax on sharp edges; saltwater rinses.
tip_3: Keep retainers clean; never boil plastic aligners.
tip_4: Labeled OTC pain relief if suitable.
when_to_seek_care: Call your orthodontist for broken wires poking or severe ulcers.

aliases: teeth whitening sensitivity|ngilo after bleach|whitening ngilo
display_name: Whitening sensitivity
tip_1: Pause whitening; use desensitizing toothpaste for several days.
tip_2: Avoid ice-cold drinks briefly.
tip_3: Shorter whitening sessions next time per product guidance.
tip_4: Do not stack multiple whitening products.
when_to_seek_care: Seek dental care for sharp localized pain that may be a cavity/crack.

aliases: night guard sore|sakit night guard|occlusal guard adjust
display_name: Night-guard adjustment period
tip_1: Wear as directed; morning jaw stretches gently.
tip_2: Return for adjustment if it causes major bite shift pain.
tip_3: Keep the guard clean and stored dry.
tip_4: Avoid daytime clenching practice.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for tooth fracture, severe bite change, or TMJ locking.

aliases: sleep hygiene|tulog routine|better sleep habits
display_name: Sleep hygiene basics
tip_1: Fixed wake time; wind-down without bright screens.
tip_2: Cool dark quiet room; reserve bed for sleep.
tip_3: Caffeine cutoff early afternoon if sensitive.
tip_4: If awake >20 minutes, leave bed for a calm activity then return.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for loud snoring with gasping, or insomnia lasting weeks.

aliases: nap too long|antok tanghali|power nap
display_name: Smarter napping
tip_1: Keep naps 10–20 minutes early afternoon when possible.
tip_2: Avoid late-day naps if night sleep suffers.
tip_3: Set an alarm; caffeine nap strategies are optional and not for everyone.
tip_4: Dark quiet spot improves nap quality.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if overwhelming sleepiness despite sleep — evaluate sleep apnea/other causes.

aliases: hot sleeper|init magtulog|night heat sleep
display_name: Sleeping too hot
tip_1: Cooler room, breathable sheets, light pajamas.
tip_2: Fan or ventilation; lukewarm shower before bed.
tip_3: Avoid heavy late meals and alcohol.
tip_4: Cool pack near pulse points briefly if helpful.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for drenching sweats with weight loss or fever.

aliases: wrong pillow|sakit leeg unan|pillow height
display_name: Pillow height neck care
tip_1: Choose a pillow that keeps neck neutral — not propped too high.
tip_2: Side sleepers often need thicker pillows than back sleepers.
tip_3: Replace flattened pillows; try a small trial period.
tip_4: Morning stretches gently.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for arm numbness or trauma-related neck pain.

aliases: new mattress sore|sakit likod mattress|breaking in bed
display_name: New mattress adjustment
tip_1: Give 2–4 weeks while using proper pillows and daytime mobility.
tip_2: Stretch in the morning; alternate sleep sides.
tip_3: Ensure mattress support matches your weight/position needs.
tip_4: Topper trials can fine-tune firmness.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe pain with neurological signs.

aliases: start walking|umpisa lakad|beginner walk plan
display_name: Beginner walking plan
tip_1: Start with 10–15 minutes most days; add 5 minutes weekly.
tip_2: Supportive shoes; warm up with easy pace.
tip_3: Track enjoyment more than speed at first.
tip_4: Hydrate; build consistency before intensity.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for chest pain, fainting, or severe joint swelling with walks.

aliases: doms|sakit after gym|muscle soreness after workout
display_name: Post-workout soreness
tip_1: Light movement and gentle stretching beat total immobility.
tip_2: Hydrate and eat a balanced meal with protein.
tip_3: Sleep supports recovery; ice or heat as preferred.
tip_4: Reduce next-session volume if soreness is severe.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for dark urine, extreme swelling, or pain after crush injury (rhabdo risk).
resource_label: NHS: Sprains, strains and joint pain

aliases: rhabdomyolysis watch|dark pee after workout|extreme muscle pain gym
display_name: Extreme muscle injury watch
tip_1: Stop extreme unaccustomed workouts that cause mounting pain.
tip_2: Hydrate if urine darkens while seeking care — do not ‘wait it out’.
tip_3: Avoid NSAIDs until advised if kidney injury possible.
tip_4: Never ignore tea-colored urine after overexertion.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for dark urine, severe muscle pain/weakness, or confusion after extreme exercise.

aliases: side stitch|sakit tagiliran takbo|exercise side cramp
display_name: Side stitch while exercising
tip_1: Slow down; deep belly breathing; press fingers gently into the stitch.
tip_2: Avoid large meals right before hard runs.
tip_3: Build distance gradually; strengthen core over time.
tip_4: Raise the arm on the stitch side while breathing out.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if pain is associated with chest pressure, fainting, or persists at rest.

aliases: exercise headache|sakit ulo after gym|exertional headache mild
display_name: Mild exertional headache
tip_1: Cool down properly; hydrate; avoid exercising dehydrated in heat.
tip_2: Check form on heavy lifts that spike blood pressure hard.
tip_3: Rest from max efforts until pattern understood.
tip_4: Labeled pain relief if suitable for residual ache.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for sudden worst headache during exercise, neurological deficits, or vomiting.

aliases: swimmers shoulder|sakit balikat langoy|shoulder swim pain
display_name: Swimmer’s shoulder care
tip_1: Reduce yardage; emphasize technique over grinding volume.
tip_2: Ice after sessions; rotator cuff/scapular exercises if pain-free.
tip_3: Check paddle/hand paddle overuse.
tip_4: Rest days matter.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for night pain, weakness, or unstable feeling.

aliases: breaststroke knee|sakit tuhod breaststroke|swim knee
display_name: Breaststroke knee strain
tip_1: Reduce breaststroke volume; freestyle may feel better temporarily.
tip_2: Ice after swim; gentle VMO/quad work if comfortable.
tip_3: Check whip-kick technique with a coach.
tip_4: Strengthen hips gradually.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for swelling, locking, or instability.

aliases: climbers finger|sakit daliri climb|pulley strain mild
display_name: Climbing finger strain
tip_1: Reduce crimp-heavy climbing; open-hand grips while recovering.
tip_2: Buddy tape only if taught; ice after sessions.
tip_3: Antagonist exercises for elbows/shoulders balance load.
tip_4: Avoid sudden grade jumps.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for a pop with bowstringing deformity or inability to flex.

aliases: gamers thumb|sakit thumb gamepad|controller thumb
display_name: Gamer’s thumb
tip_1: Take hourly hand breaks; stretch thumbs/forearms.
tip_2: Adjust sensitivity to reduce mash force; ice if sore.
tip_3: Alternate controllers/input methods.
tip_4: Strengthen grip gradually off-game.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for numbness or swelling after trauma.

aliases: esports neck|sakit leeg gaming|gaming posture neck
display_name: Gaming neck strain
tip_1: Monitor at eye level; 5-minute mobility every hour.
tip_2: External reminders/timers beat ‘one more match’ posture collapse.
tip_3: Strengthen upper back; heat for tight muscles.
tip_4: Chair lumbar support helps.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for arm weakness or severe headache with neck stiffness/fever.

aliases: vr sickness|hilo vr|virtual reality nausea
display_name: VR motion sickness
tip_1: Start with short sessions; sit for the first uses.
tip_2: Use higher frame-rate settings; keep a fan on your face.
tip_3: Stop at first strong nausea; look at a fixed real-world object.
tip_4: Avoid VR on an empty stomach or right after heavy meals if sensitive.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for persistent vertigo, hearing changes, or neurological deficits.

aliases: roller coaster sore|sakit leeg after amusement|theme park strain
display_name: After amusement-park strain
tip_1: Rest neck/back; heat or ice as comfortable.
tip_2: Hydrate; labeled pain relief if suitable.
tip_3: Avoid another high-G ride the same day if sore.
tip_4: Gentle mobility next day.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care after head injury symptoms, fainting, or severe neck pain with numbness.

aliases: concert tinnitus|ugong after concert|loud music ears
display_name: After-concert ear ringing
tip_1: Rest ears in quiet; avoid more loud exposure for days.
tip_2: Future shows: wear earplugs; stand farther from speakers.
tip_3: Limit headphone volume afterward.
tip_4: Most temporary ringing fades — protect hearing going forward.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for lasting hearing loss, pain, discharge, or tinnitus with vertigo.

aliases: festival dehydration|uhaw concert|heat crowd dehydration
display_name: Crowd/heat dehydration
tip_1: Schedule water breaks; ORS if heavy sweating.
tip_2: Buddy system; rest in shade; light clothing.
tip_3: Limit excess alcohol in heat.
tip_4: Know exit/medical tent locations.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for confusion, fainting, no urine, or heat emergency signs.

aliases: hangover nausea|sumerko resaca|nausea after drinking
display_name: Hangover nausea
tip_1: Sip ORS/water; bland carbs when able.
tip_2: Rest upright; avoid more alcohol (‘hair of the dog’).
tip_3: Ginger tea may help some; labeled anti-nausea only if suitable.
tip_4: Sleep and time are the main cure.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for vomiting blood, severe abdominal pain, or chest pain.

aliases: secondhand smoke|usok sigarilyo secondhand|iwas usok
display_name: Secondhand smoke avoidance
tip_1: Keep home/car smoke-free; step outside agreements for smokers.
tip_2: Ask for smoke-free seating; ventilate when possible.
tip_3: Protect children and pregnant people especially.
tip_4: Support cessation resources for household smokers.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for wheeze, chest pain, or recurrent infections tied to exposure.

aliases: vape cough|ubo vape|e-cig throat irritate
display_name: Vape irritation
tip_1: Stopping exposure is the most effective step; throat lozenges only mask briefly.
tip_2: Hydrate; avoid stacking other irritants (smoke, dust).
tip_3: Do not use as ‘harmless’ around children.
tip_4: Discuss cessation supports with a clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for chest pain, shortness of breath, or coughing blood.

aliases: quit smoking day1|quit cig day one|unang araw tigil sigarilyo
display_name: Quit-smoking day-one tips
tip_1: Remove ashtrays/lighters; tell supporters your quit date.
tip_2: Use approved NRT/medicines as planned with a clinician/pharmacist.
tip_3: Drink water; delay-distract-deep breathe through urges.
tip_4: Avoid alcohol triggers early if they cue smoking.
when_to_seek_care: Seek help early for relapse cycles — quitting often takes several tries.

aliases: nicotine patch itch|kati patch|nrt skin irritation
display_name: Nicotine patch skin itch
tip_1: Rotate sites daily; apply to clean dry hairless skin.
tip_2: Do not cut patches unless product says so.
tip_3: Hydrocortisone cream around (not under) may help mild itch if suitable.
tip_4: Try a different brand/strength plan with pharmacist advice.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe rash, swelling, or chest symptoms.

aliases: caffeine anxiety|kabado kape|coffee jitters
display_name: Caffeine jitters
tip_1: Switch to half-caf or earlier cutoff times.
tip_2: Eat with coffee; hydrate.
tip_3: Slow breathing if jitters peak; short walk.
tip_4: Watch hidden caffeine in energy drinks/tea.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for chest pain, fainting, or panic that does not settle.

aliases: energy drink crash|hilo energy drink|energy beverage aftereffects
display_name: Energy-drink aftereffects
tip_1: Stop further energy drinks that day; hydrate.
tip_2: Eat a balanced meal; rest heart rate with calm breathing.
tip_3: Avoid mixing with alcohol.
tip_4: Read caffeine totals — multiple cans add up fast.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for chest pain, severe palpitations, or collapse.

aliases: palpitations mild caffeine|tibok puso after kape|heart flutter caffeine
display_name: Caffeine-related palpitations
tip_1: Sit/lie down; stop caffeine/alcohol; sip water.
tip_2: Slow breathing; check if you skipped meals.
tip_3: Note duration and associated symptoms for the clinician.
tip_4: Avoid stimulants until reviewed.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for chest pain, shortness of breath, fainting, or palpitations with known heart disease.

aliases: anemia fatigue watch|pagod possible anemia|low iron suspect
display_name: Possible anemia fatigue watch
tip_1: Rest pacing; iron-rich foods if diet allows while arranging testing.
tip_2: Do not start high-dose iron blindly without advice.
tip_3: Note heavy periods, black stools, or vegetarian diet for the visit.
tip_4: Hydrate and sleep regularly.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for breathlessness at rest, chest pain, fainting, or confirmed need for labs.

aliases: vitamin d habits|araw vitamin d|safe sun vitamin d
display_name: Vitamin D / safe sun habits
tip_1: Short outdoor daylight exposures as appropriate for your skin type; avoid burns.
tip_2: Discuss testing/supplements with a clinician rather than megadosing.
tip_3: Dietary sources (fortified milk, fatty fish) can help some people.
tip_4: Sunscreen still matters for skin cancer prevention during longer sun.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for bone pain, muscle weakness, or malabsorption conditions.

aliases: how to use ors|paano ors|oral rehydration mix
display_name: How to use ORS
tip_1: Mix ORS packet with the exact amount of clean water on the label — not soda.
tip_2: Give small frequent sips; continue even if vomiting (pause briefly then restart).
tip_3: Keep giving ORS after each loose stool when possible.
tip_4: Continue age-appropriate feeding alongside ORS.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for lethargy, no urine, bloody diarrhea, or inability to drink.

aliases: dengue mosquito control|iwas dengue home|clean 4 oclock habit
display_name: Home dengue mosquito control
tip_1: Scrub and empty water containers weekly; cover tanks.
tip_2: Dispose of tire/trash water collectors; clean gutters.
tip_3: Use screens/nets; repellents as labeled.
tip_4: Community clean-ups multiply impact.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for dengue warning signs if febrile — control tips do not treat dengue.

aliases: leptospirosis watch|baha rat urine|flood fever watch
display_name: Flood-water infection watch
tip_1: Avoid wading in floodwater when possible; wear protective boots if you must.
tip_2: Wash thoroughly after exposure; cover open cuts.
tip_3: Do not swallow floodwater; boil/treat drinking water.
tip_4: Note fever/muscle pain after floods for urgent review.
when_to_seek_care: Seek prompt care for fever after flood exposure — early assessment matters.

aliases: tb cough watch|ubo 2 weeks|possible tb symptoms
display_name: Chronic cough TB watch
tip_1: Wear a mask and improve ventilation while arranging testing if TB is possible.
tip_2: Do not self-medicate with leftover antibiotics.
tip_3: Note night sweats, weight loss, and fever for the clinician.
tip_4: Protect infants and immunocompromised contacts.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for cough >2 weeks with red-flag systemic symptoms — needs clinical testing.

aliases: bp lifestyle|iwas alta presyon habits|blood pressure habits
display_name: Blood-pressure lifestyle habits
tip_1: Reduce salty processed foods; walk most days; keep a steady sleep schedule.
tip_2: Limit excess alcohol; take prescribed BP medicines as directed.
tip_3: Home BP logs can help visits — use a validated cuff if possible.
tip_4: Manage stress with realistic routines.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for chest pain, stroke signs, or severely high readings with symptoms.

aliases: stroke FAST|hika ng stroke signs|face arm speech
display_name: Stroke warning signs
tip_1: Remember FAST: Face droop, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to emergency care.
tip_2: Do not wait for symptoms to ‘rest off’.
tip_3: Note the time symptoms started.
tip_4: Keep the person safe from falls while calling emergency services.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care immediately for FAST signs — not a home-care condition.

aliases: heart attack signs|sakit dibdib emergency|possible mi
display_name: Possible heart-attack signs
tip_1: Stop activity; sit/lie comfortably while calling emergency services.
tip_2: Chew aspirin only if previously advised for this situation and not allergic.
tip_3: Loosen tight clothes; keep someone with you.
tip_4: Do not drive yourself if possible.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care for crushing chest pain, cold sweat, or pain to jaw/arm — emergency, not self-care.

aliases: seizure first aid|convulsion first aid|atake first aid
display_name: Seizure first aid
tip_1: Protect the head; clear sharp objects; roll to side when possible; do not force objects into the mouth.
tip_2: Time the seizure; stay until fully aware.
tip_3: Do not restrain movements hard.
tip_4: Loosen tight clothing around the neck.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care for first seizure, seizure >5 minutes, repeated seizures, injury, or pregnancy.

aliases: choking adult|sinimid|cannot cough speak
display_name: Choking emergency awareness
tip_1: If the person can cough forcefully, encourage coughing; do not blind finger sweeps.
tip_2: If cannot breathe/speak, call emergency help and use trained Heimlich/protocol for your setting.
tip_3: For trained responders: follow current BLS guidelines.
tip_4: After any serious choking, get medical review.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care immediately for ineffective breathing — this is not routine self-care.

aliases: recovery position|position after faint|unconscious breathing
display_name: Recovery position reminder
tip_1: If unconscious but breathing normally, place in recovery position to protect the airway.
tip_2: Call emergency services; monitor breathing.
tip_3: Do not give food/drink until fully alert.
tip_4: Treat injuries you can see without moving the spine if trauma is suspected — wait for help.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care for any unexplained loss of consciousness.

aliases: poison exposure|nakain lason|chemical ingestion
display_name: Possible poisoning
tip_1: Do not induce vomiting unless a poison professional told you to.
tip_2: Move to fresh air for inhaled exposures; bring the container/label.
tip_3: Rinse skin/eyes as appropriate while calling emergency/poison guidance.
tip_4: Keep the person calm and NPO (nothing by mouth) until advised.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care / poison center guidance immediately.

aliases: mental health crisis|suicidal thoughts|crisis help
display_name: Mental-health crisis
tip_1: If you are in danger, contact local emergency services or a crisis hotline now.
tip_2: Stay with a trusted person; remove access to means of harm when safe to do so.
tip_3: You deserve support — crisis feelings can pass with help.
tip_4: Follow up with mental-health services after the immediate crisis.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency help immediately for suicidal plans/intent or inability to stay safe.

aliases: red itchy eyes allergy vs viral|pula mata tip|eye redness tips
display_name: Red eye comfort tips
tip_1: Avoid rubbing; cool compresses; discard eye makeup while red.
tip_2: Wash hands; do not share towels.
tip_3: Lubricating drops may soothe; stop contact lenses until cleared.
tip_4: Note itch (allergy) vs sticky discharge (often infectious) for the clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for pain, light sensitivity, vision loss, or newborn eye redness.

aliases: neti pot safe|sinus rinse safe|safe nasal wash
display_name: Safe sinus rinse habits
tip_1: Use only boiled-cooled, distilled, or sterile water — never plain untreated tap in devices.
tip_2: Clean and dry the bottle after each use.
tip_3: Gentle pressure; stop if ears hurt sharply.
tip_4: Saline packets as labeled; do not invent strong salt mixes.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for fever with facial swelling or rinse after recent nose surgery without advice.

aliases: humidifier mold|linis humidifier|dirty humidifier cough
display_name: Humidifier hygiene
tip_1: Empty and dry daily; deep-clean per manufacturer to stop mold/bacteria.
tip_2: Use clean water; avoid over-humidifying (aim comfortable, not wet walls).
tip_3: Replace filters as directed.
tip_4: White vinegar cleans help some units — rinse thoroughly after.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if cough/wheeze worsens with humidifier use — dirty tanks can irritate lungs.

aliases: pulse oximeter home|oximeter tip|spo2 home
display_name: Home pulse-oximeter tips
tip_1: Warm the finger; sit still; remove dark nail polish if readings fail.
tip_2: Know your usual baseline when well; trend matters more than one number.
tip_3: Match readings with how you feel — do not ignore distress with a ‘normal’ toy reading.
tip_4: Use a quality device; cheap sensors can be wrong.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for breathing distress or sustained low readings with symptoms — devices do not replace clinical judgment.

aliases: home bp tips|paano magbp sa bahay|blood pressure cuff home
display_name: Home BP measurement tips
tip_1: Sit 5 minutes feet flat; cuff on bare arm at heart level; no talking.
tip_2: Avoid caffeine/exercise 30 minutes before.
tip_3: Take 2–3 readings and average; log them for visits.
tip_4: Use a validated upper-arm cuff sized for your arm.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for chest pain, stroke signs, or very high readings with symptoms.

aliases: peak flow meter|peak flow hika|asthma peak flow
display_name: Peak-flow meter habits
tip_1: Use the same meter standing; best of three blows as taught.
tip_2: Know your personal best and action-plan zones from your clinician.
tip_3: Clean per instructions; do not share mouthpieces when sick.
tip_4: Record readings during flares for the visit.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for red-zone readings or severe asthma symptoms — follow your written plan.

aliases: spacer inhaler|gamit spacer|asthma spacer tip
display_name: Inhaler spacer tips
tip_1: Shake MDI; one puff into spacer at a time; slow breathe in as taught.
tip_2: Rinse mouth after steroid inhalers; wash spacer regularly.
tip_3: Replace inhaler when empty per dose counter — do not float-test reliably.
tip_4: Keep a spare rescue inhaler if prescribed.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care if rescue inhaler fails to relieve severe wheeze.

aliases: sick day medicines|gamot kapag may sakit rules|diabetes sick day
display_name: Sick-day medicine habits
tip_1: Follow your clinician’s sick-day rules for diabetes/heart/BP medicines — do not guess stops/starts.
tip_2: Keep taking essentials unless told otherwise; vomiting may need urgent advice.
tip_3: Write questions for the pharmacist/clinician.
tip_4: Store ORS and thermometer accessible.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care when you cannot keep medicines/fluids down or chronic disease destabilizes.

aliases: pill organizer|weekly pill box|gamot weekly box
display_name: Pill organizer safety
tip_1: Fill in good light with labels visible; one person checks when possible.
tip_2: Keep original bottles for renewals and recalls.
tip_3: Do not mix patches/liquids that do not belong in boxes.
tip_4: Store away from children/pets and humidity.
when_to_seek_care: Seek help from a pharmacist if you are unsure which tablets look alike — mix-ups can be dangerous.

aliases: heat fold rash|intertrigo|pantal fold|rash in folds
display_name: Skin-fold moisture rash
tip_1: Pat skin folds dry after bathing; change out of damp clothes quickly.
tip_2: For skin-fold moisture rash: use fragrance-free moisturizer on intact dry skin.

aliases: general|non urgent|mild symptoms|not sure

when_to_seek_care: Book a consultation if symptoms persist, worsen, or you become unsure — you may choose to see a licensed doctor anytime.

aliases: home blood pressure|bp monitor home|check bp at home|home bp cuff|sukaton ang pressure
display_name: Home blood pressure check (mild)
tip_1: Sit quietly 5 minutes before measuring; feet flat, arm supported at heart level.
tip_2: Use a validated upper-arm cuff that fits; avoid talking during the reading.
tip_3: Take 2 readings 1–2 minutes apart and note the average with time of day.
tip_4: Share a week of home readings with your clinician rather than reacting to one number.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for chest pain, severe headache, vision changes, or BP readings your clinician flagged as urgent.

aliases: low salt diet|less salt meals|dash style plate|reduce sodium|konti asin
display_name: Lower-salt heart-friendly plate
tip_1: Cook with herbs, calamansi, garlic, and pepper instead of extra table salt.
tip_2: Limit processed meats, instant noodles, and salty snacks most days.
tip_3: Read labels for sodium; rinse canned goods when possible.
tip_4: Aim for more vegetables, fish, and whole grains on most plates.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for sudden chest pain, fainting, or swelling of legs with breathing trouble.

aliases: cholesterol diet|lower cholesterol food|heart healthy fats|less fried food|konti mantika
display_name: Cholesterol-friendly food swaps
tip_1: Swap deep-fried foods for grilled, steamed, or air-fried options when able.
tip_2: Choose fish, beans, and lean meats more often than fatty processed meats.
tip_3: Use small amounts of healthy oils; avoid trans-fat snacks when labeled.
tip_4: Add oats, fruits, and vegetables for fiber that supports heart health.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if you have known heart disease with new chest pressure or sudden weakness.

aliases: palpitations mild|heart flutter mild|racing heart caffeine|mabilis tibok|heart skip mild
display_name: Mild palpitations after caffeine
tip_1: Pause coffee, energy drinks, and excess tea for a day and rest seated.
tip_2: Sip water and avoid sudden intense exercise until the flutter settles.
tip_3: Note triggers (stress, skipped meals, nicotine) to share with your clinician.
tip_4: Practice slow breathing for a few minutes in a quiet place.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for chest pain, fainting, severe shortness of breath, or palpitations with dizziness.

aliases: heart healthy walk|brisk walk start|cardio walk mild|lakad para puso
display_name: Starting a heart-healthy walk habit
tip_1: Begin with short daily walks you can finish without severe chest discomfort.
tip_2: Wear supportive shoes and warm up with a slow 3–5 minute stroll.
tip_3: Build time gradually; consistency matters more than speed at first.
tip_4: Stop and rest if you feel chest pressure, unusual breathlessness, or dizziness.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for chest pain, sudden breathlessness, or fainting during/after activity.

aliases: pinggang pinoy|half plate veggies|go grow glow plate|balanced filipino plate
display_name: Pinggang Pinoy–style balanced plate
tip_1: Fill about half your plate with vegetables and some fruit.
tip_2: Use a quarter for rice/carbohydrates and a quarter for fish, egg, or other protein.
tip_3: Choose water or unsweetened drinks with meals instead of soda.
tip_4: Keep fried and sugary sides as occasional treats, not daily defaults.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for unintentional weight loss, inability to eat/drink, or nutrition advice needs in pregnancy/illness.

aliases: iron rich foods|anemia diet mild|iron foods|pagkain may iron|kulang sa dugo diet
display_name: Iron-rich everyday meals
tip_1: Include lean meat, fish, eggs, beans, or dark leafy greens regularly.
tip_2: Pair plant iron sources with vitamin C foods (tomato, calamansi) when possible.
tip_3: Limit tea/coffee with iron-rich meals if your clinician advised absorption tips.
tip_4: Do not start high-dose iron pills without advice—dosing depends on labs.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe fatigue, pale skin with dizziness, black stools on iron, or pregnancy anemia concerns.

aliases: iodized salt|salt iodization|asin may iodine|iodine salt home
display_name: Use iodized salt at home
tip_1: Prefer iodized table salt for home cooking when salt is used.
tip_2: Store salt in a closed container away from humidity.
tip_3: Still keep total salt intake moderate for blood pressure health.
tip_4: Ask about iodine needs if you are pregnant or on a special diet.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for neck swelling, unexplained weight change, or pregnancy nutrition concerns.

aliases: ors mixing|how to mix ors|oral rehydration prepare|timpla ors|oralite mix
display_name: Mixing ORS correctly
tip_1: Use the full packet with the exact amount of clean water on the label.
tip_2: Stir until dissolved; do not add extra sugar or milk to the ORS mix.
tip_3: Give small frequent sips rather than large gulps if nauseated.
tip_4: Discard leftover mixed ORS per package timing guidance.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for inability to keep fluids down, bloody stool, high fever, or signs of severe dehydration.

aliases: zinc diarrhea|zinc for diarrhea child|zinc supplement diarrhea|zinc libang
display_name: Zinc support during diarrhea (as advised)
tip_1: Continue ORS/fluids as the first priority during diarrhea.
tip_2: If a clinician/pharmacist advised zinc for a child, follow age dose exactly.
tip_3: Keep offering age-appropriate food when the child can eat.
tip_4: Wash hands after toilet use and before preparing food.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for bloody diarrhea, persistent vomiting, lethargy, or dehydration signs.

aliases: sugar cutback drinks|soda swap water|less sweet drinks|konti softdrinks|reduce sugary drinks
display_name: Cut back on sugary drinks
tip_1: Replace one soda/juice per day with water or unsweetened tea.
tip_2: Check labels for hidden sugars in sweetened coffee and energy drinks.
tip_3: Keep sweets for occasional treats rather than daily meals.
tip_4: Support energy with regular meals and sleep instead of sugary spikes.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for extreme thirst, unexplained weight loss, or known diabetes with unstable sugars.

aliases: water goal|drink more water|hydration goal|uminom tubig araw araw
display_name: Steady daily hydration habit
tip_1: Sip water through the day rather than only when very thirsty.
tip_2: Increase fluids in heat, exercise, or fever unless your clinician restricts fluids.
tip_3: Use a reusable bottle as a simple reminder at work or school.
tip_4: Include watery foods (soup, fruit) if plain water is hard to finish.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for confusion, very dark urine with dizziness, or fluid restriction orders from your clinician.

aliases: fever infant watch|baby fever caution|infant high temperature|lagnat sang bata watch
display_name: Infant fever — home caution
tip_1: For young infants, do not rely on home self-care alone—use age-appropriate guidance.
tip_2: Dress lightly, offer feeds/fluids as usual if the child is alert and drinking.
tip_3: Do not give aspirin to children or teens.
tip_4: Note temperature, time, and other symptoms for the clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for fever in young infants, lethargy, poor feeding, rash, stiff neck, or breathing trouble.

aliases: dehydration child|child dry mouth|bata dehydrated|sunken eyes child mild
display_name: Child dehydration early checks
tip_1: Offer frequent small sips of ORS or appropriate fluids.
tip_2: Watch urine output, alertness, and ability to drink.
tip_3: Continue breastfeeding if that is the child’s usual feed.
tip_4: Avoid forcing large volumes that trigger more vomiting.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for no tears, very dry mouth, lethargy, no urine for many hours, or repeated vomiting.

aliases: vaccine site sore|arm sore after shot|bakuna masakit|injection site ache
display_name: Sore arm after vaccination
tip_1: Move the arm gently through the day to reduce stiffness.
tip_2: A cool clean cloth on the site may comfort mild soreness.
tip_3: Use labeled age-appropriate pain relief only if suitable and advised.
tip_4: Keep the area clean; avoid rubbing forcefully.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for high fever, spreading redness, difficulty breathing, or severe allergic signs after a shot.

aliases: cold medicine child|otc cough child avoid|no cough syrup infant|ubat sipon bata
display_name: Cold medicine caution in children

tip_3: Never use adult dosing for children.
tip_4: Honey may soothe cough in older children only (not under 1 year).
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for fast breathing, chest indrawing, blue lips, poor feeding, or fever in infants.

aliases: aspirin reye|no aspirin kids|aspirin children avoid|aspirin bata bawal
display_name: Avoid aspirin in children/teens

tip_3: Keep adult medicines out of children’s reach.
tip_4: Read every label for hidden salicylates if advised.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for unusual sleepiness, persistent vomiting, or behavior change during a viral illness.

aliases: screen time kids|kids device break|bata cellphone break|child screen eyes
display_name: Screen breaks for children’s eyes
tip_1: Use the 20-20-20 idea: look far away regularly during homework screens.

tip_3: Encourage outdoor play daily when safe.
tip_4: Stop screens for sleep wind-down before bedtime.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for sudden vision loss, eye injury, severe pain, or persistent double vision.

aliases: prenatal vitamins|folic acid pregnancy|buntis vitamins|prenatal folate
display_name: Prenatal vitamins (as prescribed)

when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe vomiting, bleeding, severe abdominal pain, or reduced fetal movement (later pregnancy).

aliases: postpartum blues|baby blues mild|after birth mood|postpartum sad mild
display_name: Mild postpartum blues support

tip_2: Talk with a trusted person about how you feel day to day.
tip_3: Keep hydration and simple meals; skip alcohol while recovering/breastfeeding if advised.
tip_4: Track mood lasting beyond about 2 weeks or worsening feelings.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent help for thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or inability to care for yourself/baby.

aliases: exclusive breastfeeding|breastfeed only months|gatas nanay only|ebf support

when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe pain, bleeding, reduced fetal movement, or allergic reaction to a medicine.

aliases: expired medicine|old pills throw|expired drugs|ubat expired

tip_3: Ask a pharmacy about safe disposal options in your area.
tip_4: Never share prescription antibiotics or pain medicines.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if you already took an expired medicine and develop concerning symptoms.

aliases: antibiotic leftover|leftover antibiotics avoid|share antibiotics no|antibiotic self start

tip_1: Antibiotics do not treat most colds and flu viruses.

tip_4: Ask a clinician if bacterial infection is actually suspected.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for high fever, severe pain, breathing trouble, or rapidly worsening infection signs.

aliases: drug interaction ask|medicine mix caution|interaction pharmacy|ubat interaction

tip_1: Bring a list of all pills, vitamins, and herbals to the pharmacy/clinic.

tip_4: Report new rashes, unusual bleeding, or severe stomach pain promptly.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for trouble breathing, facial swelling, fainting, or severe allergic signs.

tip_4: Keep receipts and batch details for medicines you use regularly.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if a medicine caused unexpected severe effects or looked clearly wrong.

aliases: storage medicine|store pills dry|medicine cabinet heat|ubat storage

tip_4: Follow fridge instructions exactly when a label requires refrigeration.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for child accidental ingestion — call emergency services or poison guidance immediately.

tip_4: Compare labels for dose and frequency every refill.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if symptoms worsen after a medicine switch or you suspect a dosing error.

aliases: glucometer finger|fingerstick sugar|check blood sugar home|glucose meter home

tip_1: Wash and dry hands before testing; use the device as instructed.

tip_3: Log readings with meal timing for your clinician review.

when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for confusion, vomiting with high sugars, very low sugar with seizure risk, or chest pain.

aliases: insulin fridge|store insulin cold|insulin storage|insulin refrigerator
display_name: Insulin storage basics
tip_1: Follow the product insert for fridge vs in-use room storage times.
tip_2: Do not freeze insulin or leave pens in hot cars.
tip_3: Inspect for clumps or discoloration before injecting.
tip_4: Use a new needle as directed; dispose sharps safely.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe low sugar symptoms, injection-site infection, or inability to take prescribed insulin.

aliases: breast lump watch|breast lump check|bukol sa suso|breast change note

tip_1: Know your usual breast feel; note new lumps, skin dimpling, or nipple changes.
