tip_3: Keep a simple note of when you first noticed the change.
tip_4: Continue routine screening advice from your clinician/local programs.
when_to_seek_care: Seek prompt clinical review for a new breast lump, bloody nipple discharge, or skin changes on the breast.

aliases: cervical screen|pap smear info|cervical cancer screen|pap test reminder
display_name: Cervical screening reminder
tip_1: Follow local age-based Pap/HPV screening intervals from your clinician.
tip_2: Screening finds problems early—even without symptoms.
tip_3: Ask about schedule after childbirth or if you missed past tests.
tip_4: Vaccination and screening advice may both apply depending on age—ask.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for unusual vaginal bleeding, severe pelvic pain, or post-menopausal bleeding.

aliases: colon screen|colon cancer screen|stool test screen|colonoscopy ask age
display_name: Ask about colon cancer screening age
tip_1: Ask your clinician when stool tests or colonoscopy should start for you.
tip_2: Report lasting change in bowel habits, blood in stool, or unexplained weight loss.
tip_3: A high-fiber diet and less processed meat support general gut health but do not replace screening.
tip_4: Keep family history notes ready for screening discussions.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for black/bloody stools, severe abdominal pain, or anemia symptoms.

aliases: smoking quit start|stop smoking tips|tumigil sigarilyo|quit tobacco start
display_name: First steps to quit smoking
tip_1: Pick a quit day and remove ashtrays/lighters from easy reach.
tip_2: Tell a support person; plan replacements for craving moments (walk, water).
tip_3: Ask about nicotine replacement or medicines that may help.
tip_4: Avoid alcohol and triggers on early quit days when possible.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for chest pain, coughing blood, or severe breathlessness.

aliases: vaping quit|stop vape|quit e cigarette|tumigil vape
display_name: Cutting back / quitting vaping
tip_1: Track when you vape and replace one session at a time with a short walk or water.
tip_2: Remove devices from bedside and study areas.
tip_3: Ask a clinician about cessation supports suited to nicotine dependence.
tip_4: Avoid dual use patterns that keep nicotine high all day.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for chest pain, wheezing, or breathing trouble.

aliases: hand hygiene|hand washing meals|hugas kamay|wash hands toilet
display_name: Hand hygiene after toilet and before meals
tip_1: Wash with soap and water for about 20 seconds; clean under nails.
tip_2: Use alcohol rub when hands are not visibly dirty and soap is unavailable.
tip_3: Dry on a clean towel; avoid sharing towels when someone is ill.
tip_4: Wash hands after coughing into them and before touching your face.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for signs of serious infection (high fever, confusion, severe pain).

aliases: food safety|safe food handling|kitchen food hygiene|ligtas nga pagkaon
display_name: Home food safety basics
tip_1: Keep raw meat separate from ready-to-eat foods on boards and plates.
tip_2: Cook foods thoroughly; refrigerate leftovers promptly.
tip_3: Use clean water for washing produce and drinking when possible.
tip_4: Wash hands before cooking and after handling raw foods.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe vomiting, bloody diarrhea, high fever, or dehydration after food illness.

aliases: clean water drink|safe drinking water|boiled water tip|limpyo nga tubig
display_name: Safer drinking water habits
tip_1: When water safety is uncertain, boil and cool water for drinking.
tip_2: Store drinking water in clean covered containers.
tip_3: Use treated/ bottled water for ORS mixing if advised locally.
tip_4: Keep child bottles and cups washed and dried clean.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for cholera-like severe watery diarrhea, blood in stool, or inability to drink.

aliases: mosquito dengue prevent|dengue prevent home|linya lamok|clean mosquito breeding
display_name: Reduce mosquito breeding at home
tip_1: Empty and scrub water containers weekly; cover stored water.
tip_2: Clear gutters, plant saucers, and junk that hold rainwater.
tip_3: Use screens/repellents as locally appropriate.
tip_4: Seek early care for fever with severe body pain or bleeding signs.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, or lethargy with fever.

aliases: malaria prevention travel|travel malaria ask|mosquito net travel malaria
display_name: Malaria prevention — ask before travel
tip_1: Ask a clinician about prevention medicines before travel to risk areas.
tip_2: Use nets and repellents as advised for the destination.
tip_3: Know fever after travel needs prompt clinical review.
tip_4: Do not self-treat suspected malaria with leftover medicines.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for fever after travel to malaria areas, confusion, or severe illness.

aliases: chest pain watch|chest pressure emergency|sakit dughan watch|possible heart attack sign
display_name: Chest pain — do not self-treat as mild
tip_1: Chest pressure with sweating, nausea, or arm/jaw pain is not a home-care symptom.
tip_2: Stop activity and call emergency services if heart attack is possible.
tip_3: Do not drive yourself if severely ill—get urgent transport help.
tip_4: Tell responders about your medicines and allergies.
when_to_seek_care: Call emergency services now for crushing chest pain, fainting, or severe shortness of breath.

aliases: gerd diet evening|night heartburn habits|acid reflux night tips|gerd dinner tips
display_name: Evening habits for mild reflux
tip_1: Finish larger meals 2–3 hours before lying down when possible.
tip_2: Elevate the head of the bed slightly if night reflux is frequent.
tip_3: Limit late coffee, alcohol, mint, and very fatty meals that trigger you.
tip_4: Wear looser clothing around the waist after dinner.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for trouble swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, or unintentional weight loss.

aliases: kidney stone mild fluids|flank ache fluids|bato sa kidney fluids|renal colic mild home
display_name: Fluids for suspected mild stone discomfort
tip_1: Drink steady clear fluids unless restricted by your clinician.
tip_2: Use heat on the back for comfort if it helps and skin is intact.
tip_3: Strain urine only if your clinician asked you to catch a stone.
tip_4: Avoid high-dose unprescribed pain regimens.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for fever with flank pain, inability to urinate, vomiting with severe pain, or blood clots in urine.

aliases: ringworm mild|circular rash fungus|buni mild|tinea corporis mild
display_name: Mild ringworm (tinea) care
tip_1: Keep the area clean and dry; wash hands after touching it.
tip_2: Use labeled antifungal cream covering a margin around the ring.
tip_3: Wash clothes/sheets that contact the rash.
tip_4: Avoid sharing combs, hats, or towels.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for scalp ringworm, many spreading rings, or no improvement after proper topical use.

aliases: sunscreen reapply|sunblock every hours|sunscreen outdoor|sunblock ulit
display_name: Reapply sunscreen outdoors
tip_1: Apply broad-spectrum sunscreen before going out; reapply after swimming/sweating.
tip_2: Cover ears, neck, and tops of feet often missed.
tip_3: Seek shade during peak midday sun when possible.
tip_4: Use protective clothing and a hat for longer outdoor time.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for severe sunburn with blistering, fever, or heat illness signs.

aliases: burnout rest|work burnout mild|pagod sa work rest|occupational burnout tip
display_name: Micro-rest for work burnout
tip_1: Schedule short no-screen breaks between demanding tasks.
tip_2: Protect one block of sleep and one enjoyable offline activity daily when able.
tip_3: Talk with a trusted person or counselor early—not only at crisis.
tip_4: Reduce late caffeine that steals recovery sleep.
when_to_seek_care: Seek help for persistent hopelessness, inability to function, or thoughts of self-harm (Hopeline 1553 in PH).

aliases: sleep apnea watch|loud snore pause breath|snoring pause watch|huni tulog pause
display_name: Loud snoring with pauses — watch
tip_1: Note witnessed breathing pauses, gasping, or daytime sleepiness for your clinician.
tip_2: Avoid alcohol near bedtime if it worsens snoring.
tip_3: Side-sleeping may help mild snoring; elevate the head slightly.
tip_4: Do not ignore choking awakenings as ‘just snoring’.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for witnessed apnea, blue lips, morning headaches with severe sleepiness, or heart disease with snoring.

aliases: vertigo bppv mild|spinning vertigo sit|bppv dizzy|lipong tumaob
display_name: Mild spinning vertigo — sit safely
tip_1: Sit or lie still until spinning eases; protect from falls.
tip_2: Avoid driving or climbing while dizzy.
tip_3: Move head slowly; hydration and rest help some triggers.
tip_4: Note whether rolling in bed starts the spin for your clinician.
when_to_seek_care: Seek urgent care for vertigo with weakness, speech trouble, severe headache, chest pain, or fainting.

aliases: cluster headache mild rest|one side eye headache|cluster pain rest
display_name: Severe one-sided headache — rest dark
tip_1: Rest in a quiet dark room; avoid alcohol during a bout if it triggers you.
tip_2: Do not exceed labeled pain-medicine limits.
tip_3: Keep a short diary of timing and eye watering/redness.
